Delhi High Court Denies Timeline for Shraddha Walkar Murder Trial

The Delhi High Court has refused to set a specific timeline for the trial in the Shraddha Walkar murder case. The court was hearing a plea seeking expedited proceedings against the accused, Aaftab Poonawala. The court's decision means the trial will proceed without a court-mandated deadline for its conclusion. The case involves the alleged murder and dismemberment of Shraddha Walkar by her live-in partner, Aaftab Poonawala.
